category: cultivated meat and plant-based meat (beef burger)
metric: Willingness-to-pay premium versus farm-raised meat

frame: Multi-Ethnic Cohort 2 adults (75 percent Chinese, 15 percent Indian, 10 percent Malay)

metric: Probably or definitely willing to try; to purchase

notes: Buddhist framing result relevant to Vietnam; not tested in Vietnamese.

metric: Role of halal consciousness

notes: Abstract only.
